verdict.rationale: Zero's own MCP.md documents an MCP server whose tools cover the full loop. Reading is covered by getting threads, listing folders and searching. Triage is covered by labels, read/unread, archive and delete. Drafting and sending are covered by creating drafts, sending drafts and sending new emails. However, the connection is weak: you authenticate by copying a browser session cookie into the Authorization header, OAuth is still 'coming soon', and an independent review found only a prose capability list with no endpoint schema or public API. missing for 10: proper OAuth or token auth for external agents, documented endpoint/tool schema and setup for Claude or ChatGPT, hands-on corroboration that end-to-end agent workflows work.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an external agent — Claude, ChatGPT, or my own — can read, triage, draft, and send my email end to end through a documented connection

citations.quote: Get email threads by ID - List emails in specific folders - Create and send new emails - Create email drafts - Send existing drafts - Delete emails

Mark emails as read/unread
- Modify email labels
Bulk delete emails - Bulk archive emails
You can connecto ZeroMCP using two methods: 1. Better Auth session token 2. OAuth (Coming soon)
Copy the session cookie from your browser cookies and place it into the Authorization header.
